The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Rarity|Rare]] [[Spells|Spell]] of [[Spell Types|Type]]: Spell Projectiles. When the default spell is cast, it swings a large glowing sword in front of the player, damaging targets and destroying most enemy projectiles.

'''Description:''' A magical sword formed from mana, fulfilling the mage's desire to exercise muscles, but a 40-meter long sword doesn't seem like something a mage would swing by hand.

Interesting fact: the shape of the sword can be different and depends on the elemental enhancement
